The '''Processing Department''' was a department used by the [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]]<ref name="TORcite" /> in [[3638 BBY]]<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|2.5}}</ref> on [[CZ-198]]. It could be accessed from the [[Republic Landing Zone]]. [[Turbolift/Legends|Turbolifts]] on the area led to the [[Supply Yard]].<ref name="TORcite" />
